subject: Make it to so that unit tests build on mac (#499)
reason: The change edits only src/unit/test_util.c, restructuring an #if defined(__linux__) guard so the unit test binary builds on macOS (test_reclaimFilePageCache becomes a no-op off Linux, and a printf is removed). It is a build fix to test-only code; no Valkey server behaviour, command reply, replication, or persistence path is affected, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it and none is needed.
